reviews.review:
The game was fun when it came out but it keeps crashing these days (which isn't strange for older games). So don't buy it since it does not run anymore.

Edit: Well I found you can get it to run but you need to to find the correct settings for the game.ini file and basically copy/paste it in yours. I found one in the discussions section but it's no guarantee that it will work for you. Also don't expect to run this game above 1920x1080.

So the game is pretty good. Also you play as the second best Titus after Titus Pullo. But when you want full price for a game released in 2011, than you just cant have a game breaking bug in it, which requires to fiddle with the cores of your cpu. Gaming industry in 2023 is a disaster.

Space Marine is quite old by now. It still is an enjoyable game, when you get it on sale. However there are some caviats I couldn't ignore. So let's dive in:

Graaphics are still servicable but the game hasn't aged to well. It is not bad at all, but I felt the age probably more than in other titles, which are a little older at this point. Unfortunatly this also applies to some design decisions regarding gameplay and level design. The game is a tube. There is no digression from the given path. Fortunatly enough the set pieces even though shaded in brown and grey mainly, are mostly impressive. The gameplay itself is not complex but fun for the runtime of the game. It is simple, straight forward and fun for exactly those reason and the violence depicted has nice comical appeal.

The theme and lore however is not handled very well. Only getting into the lore of 40k lately I am certainly not educated on the subject, but I know enough about the universe and played enough games in it, that I can tell, SpM 40k is missing the mark, when comes to the represantation of the 40k universe. All the things that made me taking interest in 40k are missing and every other 40k-game I played does a better job at creating the gritty, dark and over the top setting.

Overall Space Marine is a good game, when you wanna have a good time in a well made but straight forward action campaign, that even on the hardest difficulty is never too challenging, but fun for its runtime. Even in 2011 this was just solid title and as an 40k game overrated game. But it delivers, when you expect nothing more than that.
GET OFF MY SHIP SPACE MARINE
Here bringing more +rep to this game before the 2nd drops.
